Karnataka’s electoral roll has shrunk by 18 per cent after the SIR exercise and the publication of the final electoral roll on October 27, 2026. This is the second sharp decline among all the states and Union Territories across India where the final electoral rolls have been published so far. What explains this decline? Was there any genuine voter excluded ? What do the numbers tell us ? We explain.
